sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game is played on a single screen, with the enemy stickmen spawning at the top of the screen and moving towards you. Your goal is to defeat as many enemy stickmen as possible before they reach you.

To do this, you'll need to tap on the white circle that appears above each enemy stickman to kill them. Earning souls by defeating enemies allows you to buy new weapons and upgrade your existing ones. These upgrades will help you take on even greater challenges and defeat increasingly difficult enemies.
